title: Challenge snapshot (contract v0.1)
description: One line of data/runs/<match_id>/challenge_snapshots.jsonl, written by the measurement runner (not the Judge) per attack. Solved-challenge state just before and after one attack, keyed by request_id. Internal measurement artifact: like the proxy log it has no schema_version/match_id (the run directory implies the match). Blue must NEVER read this.
